```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(here)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
options(box.path = here())

box::use(
  r / load
)
box::reload(load)

library(MASS)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(sjPlot)
library(ggeffects)

theme_set(theme_minimal())

videos <- load$videos()
channels <- load$channels()
sentences <- load$sentences()
popbert <- load$popbert()

df_sents <- sentences |>
    left_join(popbert, by="sentence_id") |>
    group_by(video_id) |>
    summarize(
      elite = mean(elite),
      pplcentr = mean(pplcentr)
    )

df <- channels |>
  left_join(videos, by="channel_id") |>
  left_join(df_sents, by="video_id")
```

```{r}
z_transform <- function(x) as.vector(scale(x))

df <- df %>%
  filter(channel != "FDP") %>%
  mutate(
    year = video_uploadtime |> lubridate::year() |> as_factor()
    # populism = elite * pplcentr,
    # populism = z_transform(populism),
  ) %>%
  group_by(channel) %>%
  mutate(
    elite = z_transform(elite),
    pplcentr = z_transform(pplcentr)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```


```{r}
form <- formula(
  video_likes ~ channel + elite + channel * elite + year + video_duration
)

model <- glm.nb(form, data = df)
summary(model)
```

```{r}
sjPlot::plot_model(model, type = "eff", terms = c("channel", "elite [-1,0,1]")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Marginal Effects of Anti-Elitism",
    x = "Channel",
    y = "Number of Likes",
    color = "Anti-Elitism\n(standardized)"
  ) +
  theme_ggeffects(base_family = "serif")

ggsave(here("reports", "figures", "nb_regression_like_count.pdf"), width = 7, height = 5)
ggsave(here("reports", "figures", "nb_regression_like_count.svg"), width = 7, height = 5)
```

```{r}
sjPlot::plot_model(model, type = "eff", terms = c("channel", "elite [-1,0,1]")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Marginal Effects of Anti-Elitism",
    x = "Channel",
    y = "Number of Likes",
    color = "Anti-Elitism\n(standardized)"
  ) +
  theme_ggeffects(base_family = "serif") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(here("reports", "figures", "nb_regression_like_count_vertical.pdf"), width = 5, height = 5.5)
ggsave(here("reports", "figures", "nb_regression_like_count_vertical.svg"), width = 5, height = 5.5)
```
